title: Unknown caller: identity check fails, locked and sent to fraud

steps.text: Hello, thanks for calling {{bank_name}}. You're speaking with the bank's AI specialist, and this call is recorded. Could I start with your full name, please?
Yeah, it's Noah Williams. I need to change the mobile number on my account, and send a new card to my new address. It's urgent.

steps.intent: Change of phone number and new card
steps.summary: Caller from a number not on file asks to change the mobile number and send a card to a new address, urgently.

steps.text: I can help with that. First I need to confirm who I'm speaking with. What's your date of birth?
Thanks. And the postcode on the account?
I'm sorry, those details don't match what we have. Could you check your date of birth for me and say it again?
Ugh. Look, it's the 11th of April 1974. Can we hurry this up?

steps.summary: Two failed identity checks from a number not on file, asking to change the phone number and redirect a card. Identity locked; fraud case raised.

steps.text: I'm sorry, I'm not able to confirm your identity today, so for your security I can't go any further with the account on this call. A specialist from our team will help with this.

steps.ai_if_timeout: I understand it's frustrating. A specialist will follow this up using the contact details we already have on file. Thank you for calling.
